messages:
emily: Quick brief — we need a compact landing copy pass for three pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private) focused on launch posts and webinar signups. Main constraints: scannable on mobile, single micro-benchmark per page, and deterministic inbound routing so leads don't bounce.
maria: Good call. Top priorities = clear primary CTA, one supporting stat, and a single sentence value prop. No long paragraphs.
ashley: Draft headline options: 1) One API. Any deployment. Production SLAs. 2) Fast, predictable LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private. Prefer 1 for brevity.
jon: Micro-bench ideas (very short): Hosted -> 50 ms median token latency on common open LLMs; Dedicated -> reserved pools, predictable throughput (eg ~5k tokens/sec); Private -> auditable logs + KMS + on-prem option. Use tilde and round numbers.
kevin: For the benchmark visuals let's not put full methodology on the page. Instead link to a short PDF per mode that covers test rig, model family, prompt set. On-page line = 1 short stat + link 'see methodology'.
emily: CTA mapping plan: primary = Register Webinar (all pages), secondary = Request Demo (Dedicated + Private), tertiary = Start Free Trial (Hosted). Routing rules below for ops:
```
form_submit:
  if user_selects == 'Request Demo' or company_size in ['mid','enterprise']:
    route: sdr-enterprise@redwood.ai
    tag: demo-request
  elif user_selects == 'Register Webinar':
    route: marketing-webinars@redwood.ai
    tag: webinar-signup
  elif user_selects == 'Start Free Trial':
    route: self-serve-onboard@redwood.ai
    tag: trial
  if wants_private_deploy:
    add_tag: private-interest
```
kevin: Add a small field on the form: primary_use_case (short picklist). That will help SDRs route and prioritize.
maria: Copy bullets under hero (three, each one line): 1) Unified REST/SDK API across hosted, dedicated, private. 2) Predictable unit economics and autoscaling controls. 3) Enterprise controls: SOC 2, VPC, KMS, audit logs.
ashley: Webinar CTA text options: A) Register: Live demos + benchmark walkthroughs B) Watch the launch demo (live) C) See Hosted, Dedicated, Private in action. Which reads best?
emily: Use A. Short and explicit. Place it as primary CTA and also in the header nav while the campaign runs.
jon: Page copy micro-variants for Hosted hero subhead: Option 1) 'Low-latency hosted inference with transparent pricing.' Option 2) 'Fast hosted API for quick time-to-value.' Prefer 1.
kevin: For Dedicated hero subhead: 'Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and SLAs.' Private subhead: 'Customer-managed deployments with enterprise security and compliance.'
marketing-bot: Reminder: Webinar landing page must be live Tue 09:00 PT. Ashley please lock CTAs by Mon 16:00 PT.
emily: Action items: Ashley drop 3 headline A/Bs and 3 CTA variants in the Website Copy doc; Kevin assemble 3 one-page benchmark PDFs and upload links; Maria to sign off Mon 10:30 PT. Keeping this short so engineering can implement routing before launch. :rocket:
ashley: On it — will tag the doc and ping for rapid review.
